timeline.summary: Kolli is hired by Morl to find where Kalenth Ush gets his silver wolf hide.
timeline.quote: Morl agreed to pay her if she could discover where the Keldon fur trapper Kalenth Ush was obtaining silver wolf hide from.

citation.text: "Animal Trap", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kalenth Ush ambushes Kolli, takes her hostage and bites her, turning her into a lycanthrope.
timeline.quote: Then, he bit her and turned her into a lycanthrope .

citation.text: "Animal Trap", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kalenth Ush kills Morl, and Kolli avenges him by killing Kalenth Ush.
timeline.quote: Kolli avenged Morl's death by killing Kalenth Ush
